h1: How do I apply for a tree removal permit in Newton, MA?
title: Newton Tree Removal Permits: Protected Trees and Construction Review
description: Learn when Newton requires a tree permit and why construction projects can trigger review even when tree removal is not planned.
short_answer: Newton requires a permit to remove private-property trees with a trunk diameter of 6 inches or greater. The City also says a tree permit is required when construction takes place, whether or not trees are being removed. The application type depends on the property, tree, and project circumstances.

facts.text: Newton states that, as of March 1, 2024, a permit is required to remove all trees with a trunk diameter of 6 inches or greater.
Newton's tree-preservation guidance says a tree permit is also required when construction takes place, whether or not trees are involved.

qa.q: Is the current protected-tree threshold 8 inches?
qa.a: No. Newton's current tree-preservation guidance states that the permit threshold is 6 inches in trunk diameter or greater.
